rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the blend spec, not a candidate: the two reference baselines of the member specs with equal weights (a condition-free clock per cause, and the published growth law with its published constants). No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables. The member values are copied from the two baseline releases by tools/wsp/blend_edits.py, which chooses nothing. Data-informed candidates of acme_inverse-wsp-v4 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
